[latent draw-order bug] `src/scenes/GameScene.ts` progress bar: the dynamic fill rectangle is drawn FIRST and the opaque `ui_progress_bar` frame image drawn ON TOP, so the fill is hidden behind the greybox frame and won't visibly animate (the code comment even says the fill goes 'over its inner track', contradicting the actual order). Fix the layering so the fill is VISIBLE and animates as progress advances: draw the `ui_progress_bar` frame FIRST, then the dynamic fill rectangle ON TOP, inset within the track bounds (keep the fill width/scale logic and the frame's key/size unchanged). Make it forward-compatible — a Phase-2 transparent-window frame SVG must still look right with the fill inside it. Correct the misleading comment to match the actual behavior.
2. [dead code] `menu_title` i18n key (`src/i18n/strings.ts`) is now ORPHANED — removing the duplicate MenuScene title text left it with no `t()` caller, violating the no-dead-code bar. Resolve WITHOUT reintroducing the visual overlap: PREFER wiring it to a real use — set the browser tab title from it (e.g. `document.title = t('menu_title')`) so the tab title is i18n-driven — OR, if you judge that undesirable, simply remove the `menu_title` key from every locale. Do NOT re-add the on-canvas title text over the logo.
3. [cosmetic] `src/config/assetManifest.ts` (around line 5) — a comment still references `scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs`; the file is now `scripts/gen-placeholders.mts`. Update the stale extension. This is the ONLY allowed edit to assetManifest.ts — do not touch any keys/dimensions.

outputs.summary:
Applied the 3 residual non-blocking cleanups from the GLM re-review. Strict TypeScript preserved. Both verifications PASS. Asset-manifest KEYS + DIMENSIONS UNCHANGED (only the single allowed comment edit).

FILES CHANGED + FIX APPLIED:
1) src/scenes/GameScene.ts — [latent draw-order bug] Reordered the progress bar so the `ui_progress_bar` frame image is drawn FIRST and the dynamic fill rectangle drawn ON TOP, inset within the track (barLeft+2, height 8 within the 14px frame). The fill is now visible and animates as progress advances (previously the opaque greybox frame was drawn over the fill, hiding it). Fill width/scale logic and the frame's key/size are unchanged; forward-compatible with a Phase-2 transparent-window frame SVG. Corrected the misleading comment to match the actual order ("frame FIRST … fill ON TOP, inset within the track").
2) src/scenes/MenuScene.ts — [dead code] Wired the orphaned `menu_title` i18n key to a real use: `document.title = t('menu_title')` in create(), so the browser tab title is i18n-driven (single localized source for the game name). Did NOT re-add on-canvas title text over the logo. Key retained in all locales; no dead code, no visual overlap.
3) src/config/assetManifest.ts — [cosmetic] Updated the stale header comment reference `scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs` → `scripts/gen-placeholders.mts` (line 5). This is the ONLY edit to this file — a one-line comment; no keys, dimensions, types, or the KEYS map were touched.

VERIFICATION (both required, both PASS):
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → PASS (0 errors, full strict-family flags). Result line: "TYPECHECK_OK".
- `npm run build` (vite) → PASS, 23 modules → dist/, NO warnings. Result lines:
    "✓ 23 modules transformed."
    "dist/index.html                 3.29 kB │ gzip:   1.38 kB"
    "dist/assets/index-Ch_5oOJ9.js  1,496.51 kB │ gzip: 343.63 kB"
    "✓ built in 2.43s"
- Generator re-run (`npm run gen:placeholders` via tsx, single-sourced from the manifest): "Generated 34 placeholder SVGs" and sha256sum -c against a pre-change snapshot → "ALL 34 SVGs BYTE-IDENTICAL" (34/34 unchanged).

ASSET-MANIFEST CONTRACT: KEYS + DIMENSIONS UNCHANGED. Verified the 34 `asset(...)` entries (keys + width/height) are byte-for-byte as before; the sole diff in assetManifest.ts is the .mjs→.mts comment. Greybox SVGs regenerate identically, so the locked Phase-2 contract is intact.

Scene flow still navigable Boot→Preload→Menu→Game→Results→(Play Again→Game | Menu link→Menu); the 3 analytics events still fire at the correct transitions. Phase 1 is clean to close.
